title: Stabilizer Orbit Action Formula
body_html:
Stabilizer Orbit Action Formula

In the one positive-depth block setting, let \(S=\operatorname{Stab}_{K_M}(w+B_0)\). On the residual oscillator model \(S(b)\), the translated orbit representation \(\omega_w\) restricts to \(S\) by \[ \omega_w(h)=\chi_M(h)\,\omega_b(h)\,\omega_b(h^{-1}w-w) \qquad h\in S, \] where \(\chi_M\) is the product of the source and target Moy-Prasad characters.
proof_html: The generalized lattice model gives the action on the translated coset \(w+B_0\). The single-block stabilizer structure supercuspidal_theta.single_block_stabilizer_structure describes the stabilizer \(S\), while the key oscillator character identity supercuspidal_theta.key_oscillator_character_identity identifies the phase term with the product character \(\chi_M\). Substituting these into the generalized lattice-model formula gives the displayed action.
